# Owner direction, precedence and packet crosswalk

Owner: Grant Wilson. Date: 2026-09-09.
Decision: `SCI-FRUIT-OD-MODE-AWARE-AND-BOUNDARY-2026-09-09`.
The [earlier boundary direction](inputs/owner/EARLIER_BOUNDARY_DIRECTION_2026-09-09.txt)
and [later mode-aware direction](inputs/owner/LATER_MODE_AWARE_DIRECTION_2026-09-09.txt)
are exact copied inputs. The owner explicitly instructed that the later one
govern disagreements. This record applies that precedence; it does not infer
approval of the finished r0.3 packet or numerical settings.

Ordinary MAP first, original-parent residual construction, residual PTC
relearning, and complete replacement remain accepted directions. The newer
direction makes full re-inference from reconstructed total, mode-aware sky
policies, separate admission/flux/application, explicit sign and gain, runtime
Learn–Consider–Apply, and stability assessment required parts of this paper
definition. Both directives authorize exact bounded interface drafting; the
newer also authorizes focused experiment proposals. Amendment adoption,
author dispatch, implementation, numerical runs and activation remain separate.

## Reconciliation

| Current packet / earlier direction | Later direction and disposition | Current location |
| --- | --- | --- |
| r0.2 and earlier §1 lead with every supported value, both signs | Mode-aware re-inference becomes the leading method. Preserve unthresholded/both-sign selection as an intentionally unthresholded comparison baseline, with nuisance protection disclosed. It is not a purified-source policy. | M02–M03, E00–E01 |
| Model and MAP support both fixed at bootstrap | Keep the fixed available science domain D_a and required PTC/MAP populations for this reference. Selected support A_k may change inside D_a, including admission and revocation. Changes to D_a or measured membership remain a separate method. | M01–M03, M06 |
| Candidate/accepted/applied values were identity copies on all support | Retain distinct roles; now construct an inference mask from total-map evidence, retain total-map flux on admitted support, then apply the explicitly declared sign/floor/gain transformation. Mask-times-total with unity transformation is the leading reference hypothesis. | M02–M03 |
| Fixed finite L; choose final required iteration | Retain this predeclared finite-extent selector only after successful completion. It is not a best-map rule or convergence claim. Instability stop is a failure/limited attempt, not successful completion. No numeric convergence or stability tolerances selected. | M07–M08 |
| Scope focused on compact-source pointing | Retain the ordinary-MAP first numerical setting and one-observation request. Specify POINT, OOF, BEAM and distinct SCIENCE policy interfaces now. These added paper interfaces and proposed cases do not admit missing numerical mode/quantity routes. | M05, B12, Q01/Q02 |
| No experiment design in r0.2 | Superseded for proposal work by later §§1/12/14. Prepare the small staged comparison below; no execution, injections or replay are authorized. | Experiments E00–E02 |
| “PTC held fixed” during a selector comparison | Hold the estimator recipe/configuration fixed between arms; each arm still relearns on its own current residual. Sharing bootstrap eigenvectors would contradict the accepted learning direction. | M04, E01 |
| Historical algorithms treated only as reconstruction evidence | Preserve exact historical PCA plus empirical S/N, with its actual optional flux cut, mapmaker and update semantics, as a practical baseline and fallback choice. A naive-map adaptation is a separate reference. A failed candidate run is not silently converted into a successful historical run. | E00, M07 |

The first-method array-wide grouping and uniform gridding family remain
proposals; neither was scientifically established by agreeing to relearning.
PCA remains the reference estimator, not FRUIT's universal state representation.
No generic-core edit is necessary: its typed method, state, model and response
roles already support this specialization.

## Directive coverage and specific remaining conflicts

| Direction | Incorporated disposition |
| --- | --- |
| Earlier §§2–3 | B01–B12 supply actual bounded PTC/MAP/coefficient/reference clauses and clause crosswalks, including PTC REQ-099. Frozen ordinary CAL and MAP routes remain unchanged in place. |
| Earlier §4 | Effective-plan recovery reuses decided centering, scaling, application, rank policy and MAP placement/support formulas. Only missing request-specific bindings or still-open producer choices are returned. |
| Earlier §§5–6 | Conditional round trip and RF/uncertainty limits preserved; the concrete amendments, source locks and remaining questions are included. |
| Later §§1–3 | Alternation, original-parent reruns, current residual relearning and replacement from reconstructed total are M01–M04. No independent evidence or monotonic improvement inferred. |
| Later §§4–5 | Evidence policy and numeric model construction are separate; all five mode regimes and mixed-field composition have explicit required inputs and exclusions. |
| Later §§6–9 | Extra floor and non-unity gain stay experimental. Alternative PTC families need their own admitted contracts. Sign belongs to the declared inference/flux policy, not a global clip. |
| Later §§10–11 | Convergence, stability, correctness and dependent uncertainty are distinct. Unknown evidence is unavailable, never a posterior, zero covariance or independent repeated detection. |
| Later §§12–14 | Focused comparisons, prospective conformance tests, runtime roles and the four requested components are present. No execution evidence is claimed. |

Two upstream conflicts are concrete. PTC REQ-099 excludes source protection
and FRUIT recurrence from its ordinary route; B01–B07 therefore define a
separately requested residual-parent pass while FRUIT alone owns protection
and recurrence. MAP REQ-052 and PTC REQ-078 do not admit raw-frequency BEAM,
OOF transfer or mode-specific inference by analogy. This revision defines the
mode-policy interface but does not turn those missing routes into calibrated
ordinary MAP inputs. B12/Q02 retain their exact boundary limits.

Prior method-definition r0.2 at
`5f93310da02c958d01c7eaf3a5b8a75e7e56c7ef` and its archive remain exact:
SHA-256 `70e35141941fbbf4abffa76b6f6314611a1434ecac01e44564344d2d9d6fabb9`.
Earlier packets, JINC work, historical products, empirical conclusions and the
two opaque review archives are preserved. Numerical recommendations still
require independent-pointing replication for the pointing regime and evidence
appropriate to every other claimed regime.
